dataset.name: CH-SIMS-v2.0
dataset.pseudo_initialization: copy one-hot multimodal class target to each modality bank

cache_input.contextual_fallback: text [N,T,D] through frozen identity encoder only
cache_input.lengths: retained in cache; source CMC encoders use fixed padded sequences without attention masks

five_class_adaptations: all author output heads change from three to five logits
main and three pseudo-branch objectives remain CE
CMC three-class SIMS polarity contrast is generalized to positive=(WPOS,SPOS), non-positive=(SNEG,WNEG,NEUT)
CMC pseudo-label alpha/nearest-one-hot update generalized from three to five classes
test is excluded from training, validation, model selection, and scoring

raw_score_policy.note: The inspected --is_pseudo source path trains CE and SupCon on three-class labels derived from regression scores; it contains no MSE/L1 regression auxiliary. No regression loss is invented in this five-class port.
